notes: On the Map, the view it opens on is now as far back as you can zoom. Trees, mountains and hills are redrawn as you move, so they stay sharp however far you zoom in, and they are drawn with more care: clumpy round trees on short trunks, pines in three tiers, snow caps with a scalloped edge and foothills, hills in twos and threes. Come closer and boulders appear, then ferns, flowers and a few sheep on the grassland
